link-pick.note: Ambiguous wordings of link-pairs.tsv asked as the link lane asks them (deterministic answers left out). Floor: the October triangulated picks measured 93.5 % right on the judged pairs.

link-verify.note: Every judged pair of link-pairs.tsv; a false accept is 'same' for a pair judged wrong, near or compound.

line-classify.note: line-labels.tsv; a false accept is a non-ingredient answer for a line that is an ingredient by rule.

repair.note: No person-judged quote cases exist yet; see docs/architecture/golden-sets.md.

prose-rewrite.note: The rewrite prompt is private to ProseRewriteHostedService; its output is checked by RewriteFidelity at run time.
